Love in Pieces

Follow the story of Ansel Draycott how he turns his curse into a
magical contract and moves himself ontop of the adventurer food chain
through what else than fucking around!
Build relationships with a wide cast of characters and use them in battle alongside Ansel. Create your dream harem!
Figure out the mistery surrounding the petrified woman Callisdra and what lies deep below in THE DUNGEON!

A mix of 3d first person dungeon crawler, visual novel style choice-based story and an action RPG fighting system inspired by Claire Obscure and Paper
Mario.

Just add yourself as a free member through the ... menu on the right
to never miss an update.
